newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan April vehicle exports rise 18.5 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan April vehicle exports rise 18.5 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's vehicle exports rose 18.5 percent from a year earlier to 362,399 units in April, the Japan Automobile Manufacturers Association said on Wednesday.
Japan's April vehicle exports to the United States rose 11.7 percent from a year earlier to 100,966 units.
Exports rose for the 11th successive month on a year-on-year basis.

Exports to the United States rose for the eighth straight month on a year-on-year basis, and exports to the European Union rose for the second month in a row. Exports to Asia rose for the first time in five months.
